description: This shell script automates testing of git protocol interactions, including cloning and fetching repositories using different protocol versions and server setups.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a git daemon with specified options, such as exporting all repositories.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running git daemon process.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a block of commands that should succeed for the test to pass, with a description.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or streams for differences.
